name: genpark-agent-dynamic-few-shot-example-selector-skill
description: Dynamic few-shot in-context exemplar selector utilizing semantic token overlap, cosine similarity and Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) diversity ranking for prompt optimization.
author: AlphaPark

tools.name: add_example
tools.description: Add demonstration exemplar to the few-shot bank.

tools.name: select_few_shot_examples
tools.description: Select top-k most relevant and diverse examples using MMR.

tools.name: format_prompt_with_examples
tools.description: Compile final prompt envelope with chosen in-context demonstrations.
